queries.query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Subscription Month'[account_key], TREATAS({DATE(2026, 8, 1)}, 'Subscription Month'[month]), "subscriptions.active_lines_eom", [Active Lines EOM])
ORDER BY 'Subscription Month'[account_key]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Account Month'[account_key], TREATAS({DATE(2026, 8, 1)}, 'Account Month'[month]), "finance.recognized_service_revenue", [Recognized Service Revenue])
ORDER BY 'Account Month'[account_key]
